claim_boundary.purpose: Exercise and audit a proposed economic-evaluation pipeline using already-inspected retained OHLCV. Results are development diagnostics, not evidence of forecast skill, economic value, or trading utility.

prospective_holdout.activation_rule: Only completed observations strictly after the committed protocol may enter a separately receipted prospective run.

result_interpretation: The generated numeric outputs are a retrospective dry run of the evaluation machinery. They are not a preregistered result, performance claim, trading signal, or option-economics study.
